claim: a parameter-free edge model predicted, BEFORE this computation, the exact integer index at which the negative Gegenbauer coefficients of q stop at N = 3000, and it is right
method: exact rational arithmetic; coefficients via the DLMF 18.18.17 connection sum (O(N) memory) rather than basis peeling; the formula path was verified against the peeling path on three (n,lam,gamma) triples first, and that check caught an off-by-one in the Pochhammer index before this run
why_it_matters: the model has no free parameters and used no coefficient at N=3000. A blind hit on an exact integer is much stronger evidence for the edge mechanism than any post-hoc fit, and it is the mechanism that explains why positivity returns at large levels.
still_open: this confirms the MECHANISM, not the theorem. The uniform-in-m steps (the edge lemma with explicit errors, and no new negative branch above the edge zone) remain unproved.
next: same test at N = 10000, where the registered prediction is 310
